thig5.6:1.1: saddhāya pabbajitvāna agārasmā anagāriyaṃ | vicari 'haṃ tena tena lābhasakkāraussukā. || ||
thig5.6:2.1: riñcitvā paramaṃ atthaṃ hīnam atthaṃ asevi 'haṃ | kilesānaṃ vasaṃ gantvā sāmaññatthaṃ nirajji 'haṃ. || ||
thig5.6:3.1: tassā me ahu saṃvego nisinnāya vihārake | ummaggapaṭipanna mhi taṇhāya vasam āgatā. || ||
thig5.6:4.1: appakaṃ jīvitaṃ mayhaṃ jarā byādhi ca maddati | purāyaṃ bhijjati kāyo na me kālo pamajjituṃ. || ||
thig5.6:5.1: yathābhūtam apekkhantī khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ | vimuttacittā uṭṭhāsiṃ kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || || Mittakālī. ||
